## 变更摘要 · Summary

<!-- 中文或英文填写即可；受影响的仓库文档仍须保持双语一致。不适用项请说明原因，不要直接勾选。
Answer in Chinese or English; affected repository documents must still maintain bilingual parity. Explain items that do not apply rather than checking them. -->

- 变更与原因 / What changed and why:
- 相关条目、文件或 Issue / Related entries, files, or issues:
- 与项目的关系（无则写无）/ Project affiliation (or none):

## 类型与证据 · Type and evidence

- 条目类型 / Entry type: 源码项目 / source project; 产品 / product; Eval / Benchmark 论文 / paper; 方法或系统论文 / Methods or Systems paper; 其他 / other
- 一手来源及其支持的表述 / Primary sources and the claims they support:
- 版本、commit 或论文版本；核验日期（YYYY-MM-DD）/ Release, commit, or paper version; review date (YYYY-MM-DD):
- 阅读范围（文档、摘要、章节或全文）/ Reading scope (documents, abstract, sections, or full text):
- 重要条件、限制与未验证项 / Important conditions, limitations, and unverified items:

## 验证记录 · Verification

<!-- 未实测可提交，须写明“仅文档核验 / documentation-only review”。区分作者报告、亲测、通过、失败与未运行；不要把演示、登录入口或有代码当作实测。
Hands-on testing is not required: state “documentation-only review” when applicable. Distinguish author reports, hands-on results, passed, failed, and not run; a demo, login page, or available code is not a test. -->

- 实际检查/运行的内容与结果；未运行项及原因 / Checks actually performed and results; checks not run and why:
- 如有实测：环境、版本、模型、任务输入/输出、成功标准与限制 / If tested: environment, version, model, task input/output, success criteria, and limitations:

## 提交清单 · Checklist

参阅 [中文贡献指南](https://github.com/Toufumind/awesome-personal-agent/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)、[English guide](https://github.com/Toufumind/awesome-personal-agent/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.en.md) 与 [许可范围 / license scope](https://github.com/Toufumind/awesome-personal-agent/blob/main/docs/LICENSE.md)。

- [ ] 已检查重复条目与分类；源码、公开可用产品、受限预览和两类论文未混淆。 / Checked duplicates and classification; source projects, publicly available products, restricted previews, and the two paper categories are distinguished.
- [ ] 已打开相关官方文档或论文原文，核对规范链接，并为新增/修改表述提供一手依据；未确认项已标明。 / Opened relevant official documents or original papers, checked canonical links, and supported new/changed claims with primary evidence; unknowns are marked.
- [ ] 已记录日期、版本与阅读/测试范围；作者报告与独立实测分开，翻译未刷新核验日期。 / Recorded dates, versions, and reading/testing scope; author reports and independent tests are separate, and translation did not refresh review dates.
- [ ] 已同步相关中英文文档及必要的来源索引；分类、条目、链接、版本、日期、可用性与限制一致。 / Updated relevant Chinese/English documents and source indexes as needed; categories, entries, links, versions, dates, availability, and limitations agree.
- [ ] 已检查受影响的 Markdown 格式、本地链接与目录锚点；验证记录如实说明通过、失败和未运行项。 / Checked affected Markdown formatting, local links, and contents anchors; verification records honestly distinguish passed, failed, and not-run checks.
- [ ] 原创文档/编选内容可按 CC BY 4.0 贡献；原创脚本/测试代码按既有 MIT 范围处理，新增代码注明许可与范围；保留署名与第三方条款，未扩大授权至全仓库、独立夹具或结果模板。 / Original documentation/curation may be contributed under CC BY 4.0; original scripts/tests follow the existing MIT scope, with explicit license and scope for new code; credits and third-party terms are retained, without extending grants to the whole repository, separate fixtures, or result templates.
- [ ] 已检查正文、提交内容、链接及附件，不含密钥、token、Cookie、私人聊天、个人信息、返佣链接或未授权复制；仅使用公开/合成示例及最小必要摘要。 / Checked the PR text, committed content, links, and attachments: no keys, tokens, cookies, private conversations, personal information, affiliate links, or unauthorized copying; only public/synthetic examples and minimal necessary summaries are included.
